batch.description: University of Chittagong (CU) A Unit question-bank collection — 2012-2013. 90 questions (Bangla 10, English 11, Physics 25, Chemistry 25, Higher Mathematics 19). Answer status: 85 verified / 5 unverified; this reflects answer-key review status, not an assertion that the question text is flawless. Import QA 2026-11-19: 22 subject labels corrected; cross-batch source IDs made importer-safe; source-conflicted keys remain unverified. This is a historical question-bank collection, not a claim that the pack count equals the official exam quota. the rest carry their best single-source key or no key, flagged per question. Explanations are null throughout (no cleanly alignable source). Single-source pack: content and keys both from Chorcha (no S1 transcription, no book coverage before 2014-15, no Phase-2 pack); all keys unverified. One written Higher Mathematics item on the Chorcha page is excluded (not an MCQ). AI-solved keys (2026-11-18, not source-verified): 0. Keyless: 0. QA audit 2026-11-19: see QA_AUDIT_REPORT.md.
